title: a survey holds every orient ref its own floor found to exist, so decompose can compose the ticket's own files
intention: When survey writes its berth, every file ref the floor measured as existing (survey_floor refs_found) that the ceiling left out of holdings is added to holdings, tagged as floor-held, before the packet is judged and berthed. The ceiling's own holdings are never removed or reworded.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akiendell: the survey berth survey-20261113T192511-ea7576778022 for ticket 0156856b1fae has orient refs [cairn/devices/cairn, cairn/tools/windowless_spawn, cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py] and the file exists, yet its holdings are six other files and omit it; decompose then refused with 'uses cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py - not a holding the survey berth carries'. The same refusal on 17d4d1899545 (engine.py, __main__.py, skill_block.py, skilldial.py, clearance.py absent from holdings) and 45a6331971fd (usage-widget-hook.json, which exists). Three live troubles share it, and akienasus saw it on ee4e. The floor already measured the file as existing; the ceiling dropped it; the judge then reds the plan's own target.
traces_to: Law 1 (the floor's measurement is settled; the ceiling must not drop it), Law 3 (a held address is a measured one), Law 7 (no silent drop).
how: In survey.py, where the ceiling packet and the floor meet before judge_survey, compute floor refs_found paths missing from holdings addresses and append {address, what: 'named by the orient refs and found to exist by the survey floor'} for each. Census rows already carry components; only refs_found (non-component paths that exist) are appended. Proof: scratch commons + repo; red first on current code, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: a ceiling packet whose holdings omit an existing orient ref comes out of the survey door with that ref in holdings; decompose_composes_holdings then accepts a compose piece that uses it
a ref the floor did not find (refs_missing) is not added, and the ceiling's own holdings are neither removed nor reworded

decisions.text: D1: the merge lives in the survey door (survey.py) so the door and the promotion gate keep one implementation; the inspector's judges are not changed.
D2: one proof over a scratch berth world, one tooth per clause, red first.

measured.saw: survey berth survey-20261113T192511-ea7576778022 (ticket 0156856b1fae): orient refs include cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py, which exists in the repo; holdings = six other paths; decompose refused on exactly that path. fixme n=1 on 0156, 17d4, 45a6 carry the same refusal text.
